say.speaker: serperior
say.text: Welcome home to the Emerald Capital, old friend. And well fought at our gates, young {lord}.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Your Majesty. Those feral beasts outside the capital walls were unlike any Pokemon in our natural world.

say.speaker: serperior
say.text: They pour from tears in the sky that scholars call the Rift. Every week more of those savage creatures strike our border towns.

say.speaker: serperior
say.text: The realms are divided in their response. Neither the Fire Kingdom nor the Ice Kingdom has been touched by Rift attacks yet, so they remain aloof.

say.speaker: serperior
say.text: Meanwhile, the proud Forest Tribe believes their own warriors can fight the Rift beasts off without outside aid.

say.speaker: serperior
say.text: However, both the Sand Kingdom and the Steel Kingdom stand in agreement with our Verdant Kingdom: we must uncover the truth behind the Rift before it consumes us all.

say.speaker: serperior
say.text: Our shared archives speak of an ancient Pokemon slumbering deep within the Ice Kingdom who remembers the Dawn Era. Quaquaval, {lord}, I entrust your expedition with waking him and learning the truth.

say.speaker: honedge
say.text: By envoy pact, my blade is yours! I am Honedge, warrior of the Steel Kingdom, sworn to guard your northern march!

say.speaker: sandile
say.text: And I am Sandile from the Sand Kingdom! Stick with me and not a single ambush will sneak past our tracks!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Honedge, Sandile, welcome to the squad! Next stop: the frozen peaks of the Ice Kingdom to uncover the truth of the past!
